title: Resumable chunked audit relay with customer-managed encryption handshake and multi-sink adapters
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Design and implement a resilient audit log relay for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments that supports resumable chunked uploads to customer-managed storage (S3/GCS/ADLS and on-prem object gateways) while preserving customer-managed encryption (CMEK/HSM), strong attestation of handoff, and robust replay/idempotency semantics. The component must work in air-gapped and intermittent-network environments, surface operator controls for manual retry/inspection, and integrate with RBAC v2 admin controls for who can configure sinks and rotate keys.
acceptance_criteria: Relay can upload a single audit stream as a sequence of signed chunks that are verifiable by the customer storage operator (signed manifest + per-chunk HMAC) and reconstituted without gaps
Supports CMEK handshake: server-side encryption with customer-provided KMS keys or envelope encryption with customer-wrapped data keys; key rotation must not lose uploaded chunks
Resumable transfers survive network interruptions: relay can resume at chunk N without re-uploading previous data and maintain idempotency across retries
Adapters exist for S3/GCS/Azure/MinIO with consistent metadata schema and tests against each provider's multipart/resumable APIs
End-to-end test: simulate 30% packet loss and confirm no audit records are lost or duplicated under normal retry/backoff policies
Operator CLI/UI: ability to list pending/resumable uploads, trigger manual resume, and export diagnostics; RBAC policies control access to these controls
Security review completed and threat-model mitigations implemented for CMEK, mutual TLS, signed manifests, and replay attacks
tasks: Design chunk format and manifest v1 (fields, signature, sequence numbering, provenance metadata)
Define CMEK handoff protocol (envelope encryption flow + KMS handshake for cloud and onprem HSM flow)
Implement adapter interface for storage connectors with fair abstractions for multipart/resumable semantics
Add resumable state store for in-flight uploads (local disk for onprem/private, durable DB for hosted) with cryptographic integrity checks
Integrate with RBAC v2 checks in Console/CLI for sink configuration and operator actions
Create e2e tests for S3/GCS/MinIO and air-gapped replay harness
Write migration compatibility layer to accept legacy non-chunked uploads and convert them to chunked manifests
Prepare docs and runbook for customer operators including example bucket policies and KMS setup
Complete security review and implement findings
decisions: Use chunked uploads + signed manifest (Manifest v1) instead of full-file ephemeral staging to reduce memory footprint and enable early commit semantics
Adopt envelope encryption pattern as primary CMEK flow to support both cloud KMS and customer HSMs without leaking raw keys
Design adapters to surface a minimal common API: startUpload / appendChunk / finalizeUpload / resumeUpload / abortUpload
Persist resumable state locally on private deployments but provide a pluggable durable store for Hosted/Dedicated deployments
Require mutual TLS for relay-to-sink control channel when connecting to customer-managed onprem gateways; fall back to signed manifests when mTLS is unavailable

Sofia Martins (Design): For operator UX, show a timeline view of chunk states and clear actions for 'resume', 'replay', 'abort' with RBAC labels.
QA Lead (Jordan Lee): Set up flaky-network CI harness to validate resumable semantics; prefer deterministic packet-drop simulation to reproduce bugs.
notes_for_reviewers: Security: pay close attention to key rotation semantics and how we store envelope keys in the resumable state store.
Infra: confirm that boltdb on disk is acceptable for private air-gapped installs or recommend alternative durable stores.
Product: verify the operator UX flows meet compliance team requirements for audit evidence export (signed manifests + server ack chain).
